scripts.start: npm run front & npm run server & npm run widget
scripts.build: vite build --mode production && npm run --workspace=widget build
scripts.prod: vite build --mode production && npm run --workspace=widget build
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=widget
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:build
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend && npm run test:coverage:build
scripts.test:coverage:backend: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --experimental-test-coverage --test-concurrency=1 --test backend/server.test.ts backend/server.lifecycle.test.js backend/server.prod-import.test.js backend/adapters/*.test.js backend/lib/*.test.js
